text.tspan: Share of one-year-olds vaccinated against hepatitis B
Share of one-year-olds who have received the third and final dose of the hepatitis B vaccine (HepB3).

tspan.tspan: WHO & UNICEF (2026); UN, World Population Prospects (2024)
Hepatitis B is a viral infection that attacks the liver and can cause both acute and chronic disease.
